c74object.name: tap.change
c74object.description: The tap.change object passes its input through only when that input differs from the previous one. Where Max's change works on numbers alone, tap.change filters repetitions of any message — int, float, list, or symbol. Novel input leaves the left outlet unchanged; a repeat sends a bang from the middle outlet instead, so both outcomes are addressable. The first input after the object is created always counts as novel. Comparison is atom by atom, and a difference in atom type counts as a change: the int 5 followed by the float 5. is two different messages, matching the behavior of the original TapTools object. Sending to the right inlet stores a value silently — no output is produced, but the next identical input is treated as a repeat. The rightmost outlet is the standard dumpout.

method.name: int
method.description: Integer input. Passed through when it differs from the stored value, otherwise a bang is sent from the middle outlet.

method.name: float
method.description: Float input. Passed through when it differs from the stored value, otherwise a bang is sent from the middle outlet.

method.name: list
method.description: List input. Compared element by element, including each element's type; any difference in length, value, or type passes the list through.

method.name: anything
method.description: A symbol or any other message. The selector participates in the comparison, so a change of selector alone counts as novel input.
